title: approval.requested
description: A gated action needs a human (agent-contracts.md §0.4 A2/A3, CLAUDE.md §1 non-negotiable 8). Emitted by core/approvals.py::request_approval() only when the caller's autonomy_level actually requires blocking approval (config-driven, config/thresholds.yaml). Consumed by the router -> a job that posts to Slack (integrations/slack.py) — never by core/approvals.py itself, which never talks to Slack (fail-closed: a Slack outage can only fail that job, never the committed pending row).

lead_id.description: Present when the action is lead-scoped (read from payload['lead_id'] by convention). Null for account-wide actions (icp_update, campaign_launch).

expires_at.description: Null means this action_type never expires (event-catalog.md §7.1: record_delete).
